about: The Abeel Firm PLLC works from International Drive in Williamsville and presents personal injury and divorce together. John E. Abeel is named as its trial lawyer and founder, and his own words on the front page are that he started the firm because he believes some lawyers prioritise their profits above their clients.

17 reviews at 5.0. It explains five stages of a matrimonial case and offers mediation. Its site publishes a disclaimer and none of the other trust pages this directory looks for, no attorney bio page and no fee.
